Name: Dashboard renders all sections with header, scope subtitle and company filter
Objective: Verify the /app dashboard loads and displays the page header, today's date + scope label, company filter, workflow stepper, all panel cards, charts and lists.
Precondition: Logged in as QA super-admin; account has seeded jobs, invoices, payments, expenses, materials and companies.
Steps:
1. Navigate to /app.
2. Observe the PageHeader title 'Dashboard' and subtitle.
3. Confirm the subtitle shows today's date (formatted via fmtDate) followed by ' · All companies'.
4. Confirm the company filter <Select> (aria-label 'Filter dashboard by company') is present with 'All companies' selected.
5. Scroll and confirm the WorkflowStepper (5 stages), Shop-floor activity, Financial summary, Job orders by status, Stock health, Purchase & raw material panels, all four charts, and the four lists render.
ExpectedResult: The dashboard renders fully with no crash (the live DOM does not contain <html id="__next_error__">); header, subtitle scoped to 'All companies', company filter, stepper, panels, charts and lists are all visible.

Name: Workflow stepper, KPI tiles, summary rows and 'View all' links navigate to correct routes
Objective: Verify each WorkflowStepper stage, BigStat tile, financial SummaryRow and list 'View all' link navigates via AppLink to its documented route without a full-page error.
Steps:
1. On /app, click the 'Material Stock' stepper stage -> /app/inventory/materials, then go back.
2. Click 'Job Orders' -> /app/jobs; 'In Machining' -> /app/production; 'Ready to Dispatch' -> /app/production; 'Dispatched' -> /app/deliveries, returning to /app each time.
3. Click the 'Open Jobs' BigStat -> /app/jobs and the 'Dispatched' BigStat -> /app/deliveries.
4. Click the Financial summary 'Payments (month)' row -> /app/payments and 'Pending payments' row -> /app/invoices.
5. Click 'View all' on Recent payments -> /app/payments and on Recent material dispatches -> /app/inventory/materials (note: NOT /app/deliveries).
ExpectedResult: Every linked element navigates to its documented route (stepper/BigStat/SummaryRow/View-all targets above) without a full page error; the app shell remains intact after each navigation.

Name: Empty-state messages render for charts and lists that have no in-scope data
Objective: Verify empty states for the expenses pie, dispatched bar and the four lists when there is no data in scope, and that the two 6-month money bar charts still render (they have no empty state).
Precondition: Logged in as QA super-admin; select a company (or use a scope) that has no expenses this month, no material issues, no pending jobs and no payments.
Steps:
1. On /app, choose a company from the filter that has no in-scope activity.
2. Inspect 'Expenses by category (month)' and 'Materials dispatched per month'.
3. Inspect the Priority jobs, Low/negative stock, Recent payments and Recent material dispatches lists.
4. Inspect 'Invoices raised vs Payments received (6 months)' and 'Cash flow: Payments vs Expenses (6 months)'.
ExpectedResult: Expenses pie shows 'No expenses this month'; dispatched bar shows 'No material issues in this period'; lists show 'No pending jobs', 'All stock above reorder levels', 'No payments yet' and 'No material issues yet' respectively. The two 6-month money bar charts render their axes/legends with zero-height bars (they have no empty-state text).

Name: Charts render bars, pie, legends, tooltips and the stock-health gauge percentage
Objective: Verify recharts visuals render correctly and the Stock health donut shows the centered whole-number percentage with 'in stock' caption.
Precondition: Logged in as QA super-admin with seeded invoices, payments, expenses and material issues across recent months.
Steps:
1. On /app, hover a bar in 'Invoices raised vs Payments received (6 months)' and confirm a currency-formatted tooltip and the Invoiced/Received legend.
2. Hover 'Cash flow: Payments vs Expenses (6 months)' and confirm the Payments/Expenses legend and currency-formatted tooltip.
3. Hover 'Materials dispatched per month' and confirm the tooltip shows a quantity (qty format, not currency) and there is no legend/second series.
4. Confirm the Stock health donut shows a whole-number percentage in the center with the 'in stock' caption.
ExpectedResult: All charts render with correct axes/legends; tooltips use currency for the money charts and qty for the dispatched chart; the gauge shows the computed healthy-stock percentage as a whole number.

Name: Company filter re-scopes every KPI, chart and list
Objective: Verify selecting a company filters jobs/invoices/payments/expenses/issues and re-computes all figures (including company-scoped stock balances) for that company only.
Precondition: Logged in as QA super-admin; at least two companies exist with distinct jobs, invoices, payments, expenses and material data.
TestData: Company A and Company B with known, differing figures.
Steps:
1. On /app with 'All companies', note Open Jobs, Invoiced (month), Pending payments, Raw material value and the Priority jobs / Recent payments lists.
2. Select Company A in the filter.
3. Confirm the subtitle scope label changes to Company A's name.
4. Confirm KPI tiles, financial summary, job-status counts, stock health, charts and all four lists now reflect only Company A's data.
5. Switch to 'All companies' and confirm figures revert to the aggregate.
ExpectedResult: All KPIs, charts and lists recompute to the selected company's scope; subtitle updates to the company name; clearing the filter restores the aggregate view. Note: stock panels iterate the full materials list but re-derive each balance in company scope, so materials with no company-scoped movement show balance 0 (counted as 'Out of stock' in the gauge) and Raw material value uses companyMaterialValue.

Name: Monthly financial figures, Net(month) tone, and Cancelled/all-time exclusions are correct
Objective: Verify Invoiced/GST/Payments/Expenses (month) reflect only current-calendar-month records, Cancelled invoices are excluded, Net(month)=payments-expenses with red tone when negative, and 'Pending payments' is all-time (not month-scoped).
Precondition: Logged in as QA super-admin; seeded invoices in the current month and prior months (incl. at least one Cancelled this month), plus payments and expenses this month and in prior months.
TestData: Invoices dated this month (mix of statuses incl. Cancelled) and last month; payments and expenses this month and prior; a scope where this-month expenses exceed this-month payments.
Steps:
1. On /app, read Invoiced (month), GST (month), Payments (month), Expenses (month) and Net (month).
2. Compare against the sum of only current-month, non-Cancelled invoice totals/tax (via computeInvoice) and current-month payments/expenses.
3. Confirm a Cancelled invoice dated this month adds nothing to Invoiced, GST or Pending payments.
4. Confirm prior-month invoices/payments/expenses do not contribute to the (month) figures, but DO contribute to 'Pending payments' if outstanding (pending is all-time over non-Cancelled invoices).
5. For the negative scope, confirm Net (month) equals payments-expenses and is shown with the red tone (green when non-negative).
ExpectedResult: Monthly figures equal the current-month totals derived by computeInvoice; Cancelled invoices contribute nothing to invoiced/GST/pending; prior-month records are excluded from the (month) figures; Pending payments is the all-time outstanding over non-Cancelled in-scope invoices; Net(month)=payments-expenses with red tone when negative and green otherwise.

Name: Job-status counts, workflow stepper and priority-jobs ordering are consistent
Objective: Verify job counts (Open, In Production, Ready, Dispatched, by-status) match job records and Priority jobs are sorted Urgent>High>Normal>Low and limited to 6.
Precondition: Logged in as QA super-admin; jobs seeded across statuses Draft/Pending/In Progress/On Hold/Completed/Delivered/Cancelled and priorities Urgent/High/Normal/Low, with more than 6 Pending/In Progress/On Hold jobs.
TestData: Known job set with mixed statuses/priorities (>6 pending-type jobs).
Steps:
1. On /app, note Open Jobs (should equal Pending+Draft), In Production (In Progress), Ready to Dispatch (Completed), Dispatched (Delivered).
2. Cross-check with 'Job orders by status' rows (Pending/In progress/On hold/Completed/Cancelled) and the workflow stepper counts.
3. Inspect the Priority jobs list and confirm it contains only Pending/In Progress/On Hold jobs, is ordered by priority rank (Urgent, High, Normal, Low), and shows at most 6 entries.
ExpectedResult: Open Jobs=Pending+Draft, In Production=In Progress, Ready to Dispatch(stepper)=Completed, Dispatched=Delivered, and by-status rows agree with the underlying records and each other; Priority jobs are correctly filtered to Pending/In Progress/On Hold, priority-ordered and capped at 6.

Name: Stock health gauge, low/negative stock list and raw-material value reflect the stock ledger
Objective: Verify stock balances (received - issued + adjusted) drive the gauge percentage and healthy/low/out classification, the low-stock list, and raw-material value, honoring the exact classification order and the gauge-vs-list filter difference.
Precondition: Logged in as QA super-admin; materials seeded to yield at least one healthy (bal>0 and above reorder), one low (reorderLevel set and 0<bal<=reorderLevel), one out (bal<=0), plus one material at exactly bal=0 with no reorderLevel and one with a negative balance.
TestData: Materials with known receipts/issues/adjustments and reorderLevel values (including one with reorderLevel undefined).
Steps:
1. On /app, read the Stock health gauge percentage and the Healthy / Low stock / Out of stock counts.
2. Confirm the classification order: bal<=0 counts as Out first; else (reorderLevel defined and bal<=reorderLevel) counts as Low; else Healthy; and pct = round(healthy/total*100).
3. Inspect the Low/negative stock list; confirm it lists materials with balance<0 OR (reorderLevel defined and balance<=reorderLevel), negative balances shown in red and others amber, capped at 6.
4. Confirm the gauge-vs-list edge: a material at exactly bal=0 with NO reorderLevel is counted as 'Out of stock' in the gauge but does NOT appear in the low-stock list.
5. Confirm Raw material value equals totalRawMaterialValue (or companyMaterialValue when scoped) and 'Materials in stock' equals the count of materials with company-scoped balance>0.
ExpectedResult: Gauge percentage and healthy/low/out counts follow the documented classification order; the low-stock list contents/coloring and the bal=0/no-reorderLevel edge match the code; raw-material value and materials-in-stock count match src/data/computations.ts.

Name: Recent payments and recent material dispatches show latest records first, capped at 5
Objective: Verify the Recent payments and Recent material dispatches lists sort by date descending and are limited to 5, showing correct labels/amounts/units.
Precondition: Logged in as QA super-admin; more than 5 payments and more than 5 material issues seeded with varying dates.
TestData: 6+ payments and 6+ issues with known dates.
Steps:
1. On /app, inspect Recent payments; confirm at most 5 rows, newest first, each showing company name (resolved), date, method and currency amount.
2. Inspect Recent material dispatches; confirm at most 5 rows, newest first, each showing material name (resolved), date, issue number and quantity + unit.
ExpectedResult: Both lists show at most 5 entries in descending date order with correctly resolved company/material names and correctly formatted amounts (currency) and quantities (qty + unit).

Name: Dashboard handles empty/absent datasets without errors (default [] guards)
Objective: Verify the read-only screen degrades gracefully when queries return no data — hooks default to [] so no NaN/undefined leaks into KPIs or charts and the gauge guards total=0.
Precondition: Logged in as a QA super-admin on a fresh/empty tenant or an account with no jobs/invoices/payments/expenses/materials.
Steps:
1. Navigate to /app with no seeded data.
2. Confirm the page renders without crashing (no <html id="__next_error__">).
3. Confirm numeric count KPIs show 0 and currency KPIs show the zero-value currency format (not NaN/undefined).
4. Confirm the stock-health gauge shows 0% (total=0 guard) and all lists and the empty-capable charts show their empty states.
ExpectedResult: No runtime error; counts render as 0, currency figures are valid zero amounts (no NaN/undefined), the gauge shows 0%, and empty-state text appears for the expenses pie, dispatched bar and all four lists.

Name: Company filter only accepts the provided options
Objective: Verify the company filter is a constrained native <select> whose only values are '' (All companies) and existing company ids, so no arbitrary/invalid scope can be entered.
Precondition: Logged in as QA super-admin with several companies.
Steps:
1. On /app, open the company filter and confirm the first option is 'All companies' (empty value) followed by exactly one option per company.
2. Confirm there is no free-text input for the scope (it is a native <select>).
3. Select each option in turn and confirm the subtitle scope label updates accordingly.
ExpectedResult: The filter exposes only the empty 'All companies' option plus one option per existing company; no invalid/free-form value is possible and the subtitle reflects each selection.

Name: Dashboard issues only read queries to Supabase and does not write
Objective: Verify loading /app triggers the expected read-only data hooks (jobs, invoices, payments, expenses, issues, materials, companies, receipts, adjustments) and performs no mutating requests or RPC writes, and that changing the filter does not fetch.
Precondition: Logged in as QA super-admin; browser DevTools/Network panel available.
Steps:
1. Open DevTools Network, clear it, then navigate to /app.
2. Confirm read requests for jobs, invoices, payments, expenses, material issues, materials, companies, receipts and adjustments are issued (GET/select).
3. Confirm there are no POST/PATCH/DELETE table writes and no create_/transition_ RPC calls triggered by the dashboard.
4. Change the company filter and confirm no new network requests occur (filtering is client-side over cached data).
ExpectedResult: Only read/select requests are made to Supabase; the company filter recomputes client-side with no extra fetches for the cached data; no mutations or write RPCs occur.

Name: Dashboard tolerates a failing query and does not render a client-side crash page
Objective: Verify the dashboard tolerates a failing/slow query (hook data falls back to []) and does not render a client-side crash page.
Precondition: Logged in as QA super-admin; ability to simulate a failed request (e.g. block one Supabase endpoint in DevTools).
Steps:
1. Open DevTools and block/force-fail one of the dashboard endpoints (e.g. expenses).
2. Navigate to /app.
3. Observe rendering of the sections that depend on the failed endpoint (e.g. Expenses(month), expenses pie, cash flow, Net).
4. Confirm the live DOM does not contain <html id="__next_error__">.
ExpectedResult: The dashboard still renders; sections backed by the failed query fall back to empty/zero states rather than crashing the whole page.

Name: Dashboard route requires authentication
Objective: Verify /app is gated by the app-shell auth layout and unauthenticated users cannot view dashboard data.
Precondition: No active session (logged out / fresh browser).
Steps:
1. Clear the session and navigate directly to /app.
2. Observe the app-shell auth gate behavior (redirect/block).
3. Confirm no dashboard KPIs, charts or lists (customer/financial data) are rendered while unauthenticated.
ExpectedResult: Unauthenticated access to /app is blocked/redirected by the auth gate; no dashboard data is exposed before authentication.

Name: Dashboard data is tenant/RLS scoped to the signed-in account
Objective: Verify the dashboard only aggregates data the authenticated user is entitled to (RLS/tenant isolation), so no other tenant's companies, jobs, invoices or payments appear.
Precondition: Two isolated accounts/tenants exist, each with distinct data.
TestData: Tenant A and Tenant B with known, non-overlapping records.
Steps:
1. Log in as Tenant A and record the dashboard figures and company filter options.
2. Log out and log in as Tenant B.
3. Compare the dashboard figures and company filter list.
4. Confirm Tenant B never sees Tenant A's companies, jobs, invoices or payment totals.
ExpectedResult: Each account's dashboard reflects only its own data; the company filter lists only that account's companies; no cross-tenant leakage occurs (enforced by Supabase RLS).

Name: Dashboard money/stock figures are derived, not denormalised — recompute after underlying data changes
Objective: Verify dashboard aggregates are computed from authoritative rows (invoices, payments, issues, receipts, adjustments) so they update correctly when source data changes, with no stale denormalised value.
Precondition: Logged in as QA super-admin; able to add a payment and a material issue through their own modules (test/staging data).
TestData: One new payment (current month, allocated to an outstanding invoice) and one new material issue in a chosen company scope.
Steps:
1. On /app, note Payments (month), Pending payments, the Materials dispatched chart and Recent material dispatches for a company scope.
2. In the Payments module, record a new current-month payment allocated to an outstanding invoice for that company; return to /app (refresh/invalidate).
3. Confirm Payments (month) increases by the payment amount and Pending payments decreases by the allocated amount (via computeInvoice outstanding).
4. In the Materials module, record a new issue for that company; return to /app and confirm the dispatched chart bucket and Recent dispatches reflect it.
ExpectedResult: Dashboard figures recompute from the updated ledger (payments/outstanding and dispatched quantities change to match) with no stale cached/denormalised values. Destructive because it writes payment/issue rows in other modules to validate derivation.
